method: Static repository scan + separately documented dated primary-source spot checks; not a live or exhaustive verification of every claim.

findings.status: PDC schedule supports pairing as of 21 Oct
findings.issue: The official PDC 19 Oct schedule and 21 Oct preview list Danny Noppert v Stephen Bunting. The slate asserts Bunting withdrew and Ritchie Edhouse replaced him, citing that 21 Oct preview, which does not support this replacement. A later PDC change is possible but has not been evidenced here.
findings.official_value: Danny Noppert vs Stephen Bunting (19–21 Oct PDC publications)
findings.action: Do not use slate's Edhouse selection, line or prediction until a newer PDC match source confirms replacement; revisit before play.

findings.issue: Official PGA Tour event page dates the Bank of Utah Championship 1–4 Oct 2026, not 22 Oct. The 22–25 Oct tournament is the Butterfield Bermuda Championship; the Utah entry is a stale event, not a live fixture.
findings.official_value: Bank of Utah Championship: 1–4 Oct 2026; Butterfield Bermuda Championship: 22–25 Oct 2026
findings.action: Suppress the stale row in originating layer; do not infer a field or market for the replacement.

findings.action: Replace fixture citation with Riot match/schedule URL; separately verify all model inputs before calling the line verified.
